7 Ways to Answer Leads Faster

Most small businesses take hours to reply to a new inquiry. By then, the lead has already talked to a competitor.

1. Use an instant auto-reply

Acknowledge every inquiry within a minute, even outside office hours, and include a booking link.

2. Qualify with a few smart questions

Budget, timeline and need tell you who deserves a call today.

3. Route hot leads to your phone

Get a push notification for every high-intent lead so you can call within five minutes.

  • Use templates
  • Track response time
  • Review weekly

Small changes in response speed compound into many more booked calls every month. & that's the point.
